title: Comprehensive Test Suite: Models, Forms, Views, URLs & Integration
description:
[QA DOMAIN TIER - COMPLETE VERIFICATION SYSTEM]

Build the full pytest-django test suite achieving 80%+ coverage across all application layers. This is a cohesive QA subsystem covering model unit tests, form validation tests, view endpoint tests, URL resolution tests, and end-to-end integration flows.

**Backend QA Engineer Scope:**

**1. Model Tests (`tests/test_models.py`):**
- Todo model instantiation with valid data
- Title field constraints (max 255 chars, non-empty via full_clean)
- is_completed boolean default behavior
- Auto-created_at timestamp population
- Auto-updated_at modification on save
- String representation (__str__) behavior

**2. Form Tests (`tests/test_form.py`):**
- TodoForm valid submission with title
- TodoForm rejection of empty/whitespace-only titles in clean_title
- TodoForm rejection of titles exceeding 255 characters
- TodoForm update scenario with partial data
- CSRF token presence verification on rendered forms

**3. View Tests (`tests/test_views.py`) - 8 Endpoints × 3 Patterns Each:**
| Endpoint | GET Test | Valid POST Test | Invalid POST Test |
|----------|----------|-----------------|-------------------|
| /todos/ (list) | 200, template, pagination | N/A (GET only) | N/A |
| /todos/?q=search (search) | 200, filtered results, Q objects | N/A | N/A |
| /todos/create/ | 200, empty form | 302 redirect, object created | 200, form errors displayed |
| /todos/<id>/ (detail) | 200, object in context | N/A | N/A |
| /todos/<id>/edit/ | 200, pre-populated form | 302 redirect, changes saved | 200, form errors, no change |
| /todos/<id>/delete/ | 200, confirmation page | 302 redirect, object deleted | N/A |
| /todos/<id>/toggle/ | 302 redirect, status flipped | N/A (POST preferred) | 404 for invalid ID |
| /admin/todos/todo/ | 302 redirect to login (unauth) | N/A | N/A |

**4. URL Tests (`tests/test_urls.py`):**
- Reverse URL resolution for all 8 named URL patterns
- URL pattern parameter acceptance (int:id)
- URL namespace inclusion verification

**5. Integration Tests (within test_views.py or test_integration.py):**
- Full CRUD flow: create → list verify → detail verify → edit → delete → list verify gone
- Search filter with pagination state retention across page navigation
- Toggle endpoint behavior verification (is_completed flips correctly)
- Django messages framework verification across redirects

**Test Infrastructure:**
- Configure pytest-django with pytest.ini (DJANGO_SETTINGS_MODULE=config.settings.development)
- Build conftest.py with fixtures: db, client, todo_instance (factory), multiple_todos (10 records)
- Implement coverage reporting with pytest-cov, 80% threshold enforcement
- All tests use Django TestClient; no mock patching of ORM

**FILE OWNERSHIP**
This agent owns: tests/__init__.py, tests/conftest.py, tests/test_models.py, tests/test_forms.py, tests/test_views.py, tests/test_urls.py, pytest.ini
This agent must create:
  - tests/conftest.py (shared fixtures: client, todo_factory, multi_todo_fixture)
  - tests/test_models.py (Todo model unit tests: 5+ test cases)
  - tests/test_forms.py (TodoForm validation tests: 4+ test cases)
  - tests/test_views.py (8 endpoints × 3 patterns = 20+ test cases plus integration flows)
  - tests/test_urls.py (URL resolution tests for all named patterns)
This agent must IMPORT from: apps/todos/models.py (Todo), apps/todos/forms.py (TodoForm), apps/todos/views.py (all view classes), apps/todos/urls.py (urlpatterns)
This agent must NOT modify: config/settings/, apps/todos/models.py, apps/todos/views.py, apps/todos/urls.py, templates/, static/
subtasks: Configure pytest.ini with DJANGO_SETTINGS_MODULE and pytest-django plugin
Build conftest.py with client fixture, todo_factory fixture (creates Todo instances), and multi_todo_fixture (10 records for pagination)
Implement test_models.py: Todo instantiation, field constraints, timestamp auto-population, __str__ method
Implement test_forms.py: valid submission, empty title rejection, max length validation, CSRF token presence
Implement test_views.py: 8 endpoints (list, search, create, detail, edit, delete, toggle, admin) with GET/valid POST/invalid POST patterns
Implement test_urls.py: reverse resolution for all named URL patterns, namespace verification
Add integration test: full CRUD flow with messages verification
Add integration test: search with pagination state retention
Verify coverage ≥80% with pytest-cov; add missing test paths if below threshold
Verify all 8 endpoints have minimum 1× GET, 1× valid POST (where applicable), 1× invalid POST (where applicable) test coverage

title: Final Integration Verification & Documentation Completion
description:
[INTEGRATION & DOCUMENTATION TIER - PRODUCTION READINESS SIGN-OFF]

Execute final end-to-end verification of all Wave 1 functionality against Wave 2 quality gates, completing all documentation for production handoff. This cohesive integration task validates the complete system works as specified.

**Integration & Documentation Engineer Scope:**

**1. Final Integration Verification:**
Execute manual and automated verification of complete user flows:

| Flow | Verification Steps |
|------|-------------------|
| Create Todo | Navigate to /todos/create/ → Submit form → Redirect to list with success message → New item visible |
| List & Pagination | Verify 10 items per page → Navigate page 2 → Verify pagination controls → Search with 'q' param → Verify filtered results |
| Search/Filter State | Search 'test' → Navigate to page 2 → Verify 'q=test' preserved in URL → Verify results remain filtered |
| Detail View | Click todo title from list → Verify /todos/<id>/ loads with correct data → Breadcrumb navigation functional |
| Edit Todo | Click edit → Modify title → Submit → Redirect to list with success message → Changes persisted |
| Toggle Complete | Click toggle button → Verify status flips → Page refreshes with updated state → No full form submission |
| Delete Todo | Click delete → Confirmation page → Submit → Redirect to list with success message → Item removed |
| Admin Interface | Navigate to /admin/ → Login with superuser → Todos model visible → CRUD functional in admin |

**2. Documentation Completion (`docs/`):**
- docs/setup_guide.md: Complete local setup instructions (clone, venv, pip install, migrate, createsuperuser, runserver, run tests)
- docs/architecture.md: MTV architecture decisions, settings split rationale, why CBVs vs FBVs, template inheritance structure
- docs/api_reference.md: Complete URL pattern reference table (name, path, view, template, HTTP methods)

**3. Production Readiness Checklist:**
- [ ] All 8 endpoints functional and tested
- [ ] 80%+ coverage verified with pytest-cov
- [ ] CI pipeline passing (flake8 + pytest)
- [ ] Security validations passing (SECRET_KEY, DEBUG, ALLOWED_HOSTS, CSRF, no |safe)
- [ ] Documentation complete (setup, architecture, API reference)
- [ ] No TODO comments or placeholder code in production files
- [ ] requirements.txt pinned with exact versions

**FILE OWNERSHIP**
This agent owns: docs/setup_guide.md, docs/architecture.md, docs/api_reference.md, README.md (update), tests/test_integration_final.py (optional)
This agent must create:
  - docs/setup_guide.md (step-by-step local development setup)
  - docs/architecture.md (MTV pattern, settings split, CBV rationale, template structure)
  - docs/api_reference.md (complete endpoint documentation: name, URL pattern, view class, template, methods, parameters)
  - Update README.md with project overview, quick start, and link to docs/
This agent must IMPORT from: apps/todos/urls.py (for URL documentation), config/settings/ (for architecture docs)
This agent must NOT modify: config/settings/, apps/todos/models.py, apps/todos/views.py, apps/todos/forms.py, apps/todos/urls.py, templates/, static/, .github/workflows/, tests/test_*.py (except optional test_integration_final.py)
This agent may EXECUTE but not MODIFY: manage.py (for verification commands: test, migrate, runserver)
subtasks: Execute end-to-end Create Todo flow: verify form submission, redirect, success message, list update
Execute List & Pagination verification: confirm 10 items/page, pagination controls, page navigation
Execute Search/Filter State retention: search with 'q', navigate pages, verify param preserved, results filtered
Execute Detail View flow: click from list, verify correct data, breadcrumb functional
Execute Edit Todo flow: modify, submit, verify redirect, success message, persistence
Execute Toggle Complete flow: click toggle, verify status flip, page refresh, no form submission
Execute Delete Todo flow: click delete, confirmation, submit, verify redirect, success message, removal
Execute Admin Interface flow: /admin/ login, todos model CRUD functional
Create docs/setup_guide.md with complete local setup instructions
Create docs/architecture.md with MTV decisions, settings split rationale, CBV vs FBV rationale
Create docs/api_reference.md with complete URL pattern documentation (8 endpoints)
Update README.md with project overview, quick start, and docs/ links
Final production readiness: verify no TODOs, pinned requirements, all gates passing
